svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.8.2 Fire-Resistance Ratings in Sprinklered Buildings
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Fire-Resistance Ratings in Sprinklered Buildings

g.text: Operation of the sprinklers sends a

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
The requirements in Table 9.10.8.1. for roof
assemblies to have a fire-resistance rating
are permitted to be waived in sprinklered
buildings where
(a) the sprinkler system is electrically
supervised in conformance with Sentence
3.2.4.9.(3), and (b) the operation of the
sprinkler system will cause a signal to be
transmitted to the fire department in conformance
with Sentence 3.2.4.7.(4).
Sentence 3.2.4.9.(3), in short
An automatic sprinkler system is electrically
supervised to indicate a supervisory signal on
the building fire alarm system annunciator for,
among others, (a) movement of a valve handle that
controls the supply of water to sprinklers, (b)
loss of excess water pressure in a wet pipe
system, and (c) loss of air pressure in a dry
pipe system.
Drawn: a slice through a three-storey building, cut faces toward you. Red dashed line: the signal to the fire department.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.8.2. (page 9-65)
